title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO SARDAR VALLABHBHAI PATEL ON HIS BIRTH ANNIVERSARY
body_text: The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu, paid floral tributes to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on his 151 st birth anniversary at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (October 31, 2026). Earlier, she also visited Sardar Patel Chowk in New Delhi to pay her respects before the statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. **** MJPS/SS/PRK
